title: CorpuscularVortex: Vortex = Corpuscle = Field in One Object
description: Unified model where vortex core, corpuscle, and field are one object. Charge equals circulation Γ, spin is ±1, mass is |Γ|. Includes magnetic field (Ampère), gravitational field, and 4 link types (STRONG, WEAK, EM, GRAV). In literature, vortex, particle, and field are separate — here they are one.
